extension.summary: Sort and rename downloads into the folders Kodi understands. Formerly Kodi Sorter.
extension.description: Turns a pile of downloads into tidy TV, Movies, Comics and Tutorials folders that Kodi's library can read. You pick a source and a destination, see every move first, and nothing moves until you say so. You can also import files from your phone over Wi-Fi, but you don't need one.
extension.disclaimer: Sortovia moves and deletes files when you approve it. Keep a backup of anything you can't replace. Not affiliated with Kodi or the XBMC Foundation.
